dirty_state_caveat: Concurrent Wave 34 multi-lane dirty tree. This lane changed only lib/services/**. Every importer named below is outside the design-system grant, so none of them was touched.
summary: 12 modules under lib/services/** are dead but could not be deleted this wave, because every one of their importers is itself entry-unreachable AND lives outside the design-system grant. Deleting the module would replace its diagnostics with a TS2307 'cannot find module' in a file this lane does not own, which is a net loss. The unlock is always the same shape: the owning lane deletes the dead importer, then this lane deletes the service. Each dead importer is listed with its owner. The single highest-value item is mfa.service.ts at 40 measured primary diagnostics, blocked on the integrations lane's test and hook.

Established the ordering constraint: the importer is deleted first, the service second, never the reverse.
